references.title: DWDS: Leiter
references.supports: No Wortzerlegung for die Leiter, the ladder; Herkunft ahd. (h)leitara (9th c.), formed with the old instrument suffix -trā, not from leiten

notes.rationale: The ladder, die Leiter. DWDS gives this homograph no Wortzerlegung, so it is a bottom word with no Constituents: the Root leiter and the zero ending (ADR 0051). der Leiter, who leads, splits leiten + -er (ADR 0050: the Reading owns the split).
